title: COMPLETE RESPONSE — Example Oncology Inc — NDA 999001
text: FDA has completed its review of your application for sotorasib. We are unable to approve the application in its present form. The dose selection is not adequately justified: the proposed dose was carried from the maximum tolerated dose paradigm without a randomised comparison against a lower dose. Provide exposure-response analyses for both efficacy and safety.

title: COMPLETE RESPONSE — Example Stroma Ltd — NDA 999002
text: FDA has reviewed your application for hyaluronidase in metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The improvement in objective response rate was not accompanied by an improvement in overall survival. A response endpoint alone does not support approval in this setting.

title: Label — GEMZAR (gemcitabine)
text: FDA approved labeling. Gemcitabine pharmacokinetics are linear over the studied range. Clearance is affected by age and sex. The terminal half-life is short and intracellular triphosphate accumulation drives activity.
